title: Same Road, Different Destinations
subtitle: Poor soul, so eager for salvation—where will you go now?

trails.title: Paper and Sand Table​
trails.description: Hundreds of people trapped on a thin sheet of paper, waiting for orders—and for rescue.

content.text:
03/30 13:05
Triglav conducted an initial test firing from 22KM, scoring a direct hit on the coastal ice shelf. Four minutes later, a second salvo was conducted for firing data adjustment. Four minutes later, a third salvo was conducted to complete firing calibration.
Reply: Commence the attack.
03/30 14:32
Magnus activated self-navigating mines. Confirmed underwater attacks on two destroyers, with one confirmed incapacitated. Magnus then surfaced, commencing gunfire while using its hull to block attacks.
Reply: ​Deploy the second wave of five destroyers to intercept Magnus. Zeno Air Force has launched fourteen reconnaissance personnel. Coordination required.
03/30 16:03
Magnus has been defeated. Fleet is advancing pending the construction of an artificial harbor by logistics units.
Reply: Monitor Igor's rebels and provide real-time situation assessments.
03/30 19:25
Triglav has advanced into the heart of the combat zone. The artificial harbor construction is now in its initial phase. Sonar has detected a massive unidentified signal. No movement detected from Igor's forces.
Reply: Emplace firearms based on fortifications. Maintain surveillance on the enemy main forces.
03/31 00:10
All Olitiaus have taken to the skies. The retreating Magnus abruptly reversed course and attacked. Two destroyers were incapacitated by Magnus's flat-trajectory artillery fire. Request heavy fire support. No signs of Igor's forces joining the battle detected.
Reply: Artillery will establish fire coverage across your 12NM forward sector in 5 minutes, with air support arriving in 20 minutes. Remain on high alert as Igor's movement toward Manus clearly indicates intentions.
03/31 02:34
Leviathan has surfaced, severely damaging Triglav. Triglav is initiating detonation of the onboard array.
Reply: All vessels evade ice zones and reorganize defense.

items.text: Same Road, Different Destinations
Lava Tube, Sanctuary
In a place as silent as a tomb, even the slightest motion can feel like a crashing wave.
The gate has opened once again.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Then it's time you made good on your word, Preacher.
The Preacher withdraws her gaze from the distance. Fingers hang over the idol at her chest as she turns.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: The stage is set. Apostle Animus is ready to preside over the ritual.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: But the mist has only just begun to rise, Admiral.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: The Foundation's fleet is still threatening our coastline. I'd expected you to be busying yourself with wartime affairs.
The admiral stands in the shadow, his eyes blazing.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: I am exactly where I must be. You know the reason.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: My men have fought from the tropics to the tundra in service of our pact. They have endured enough. It ends today.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: That is a cost you should have anticipated when you entered the pact.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Anticipation is not the same as endurance.
He remains still.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Now the final piece has fallen into place, and we have done all THEY asked of us.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: It's time that you fulfilled your promise—the "boon" for my army.
The Preacher studies him, as if weighing his contribution. After a moment, she nods.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Very well.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: As we agreed—

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: —An army for a "boon."

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Flamo   Flicker.
The moment her fingers touch the box's surface, arcane energy vanishes into void, leaving not a single mark behind.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: If only we had claimed it sooner ...

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: If only we had held it in our hands in 1999 ...
The Preacher shakes her head, then presses her hand against the box.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: The fruit is not yet ripened, Admiral. To pluck it too soon is to bring ruin.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: The "boon" will grant precisely what you asked, but not without a price. Take heed of my words: some doors are better left unopened.
She shifts her vision up to the admiral's chest, where his silver insignia glints under the cold sun. Awarded for surviving multiple "Storms," it remains polished, like new.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: I trust you laid down your past when you chose to stand with us.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: My path is set, Preacher.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Then do not stray, Admiral.
The admiral brushes her hand aside, tucking the "boon" into his coat. He leaves the frozen den without so much as a backward glance.
The communicator crackles to life.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Admiral.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: The pact is concluded.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Understood. What are your orders?

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Proceed to the next stage.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Yes, sir.
The one on the other end of the line breathes evenly.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: But may I first request permission to attend to a personal matter?

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: A personal matter?
He lets out a soft chuckle.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: *chuckle* Permission granted. Do as you see fit.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Thank you, Father.
The call ends.
The admiral looks down, rubbing his calloused palm—every bump and scab familiar.
As familiar as each of his children.
Former Zeno Sentinel Unit Station
Moldir takes a deep breath, the icy air forcing every fiber of her body awake.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Standby is lifted. We are clear to proceed. Sergeant White Gloves?

items.speaker: Sergeant White Gloves
items.text: Lieutenant! Did you just ...
The sergeant watches his superior. The gleam in her eyes holds the same unyielding resolve that once belonged to her father.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: You heard me. Eliminate the Manus spies. Prepare for immediate evacuation.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Comms, block all intercepting Manus signals and get Ptolemy on the line.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Where is Captain Danilov?

items.speaker: Aircraft Captain
items.text: Here, Lieutenant. And I have good news.

items.speaker: Aircraft Captain
items.text: Your arcane skill did the trick. The helicopter is now fully operational.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Very good, Captain.
Returning the captain's salute, Moldir marches through the snow toward the helicopter.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: This is the path we have chosen. There will be no straying from it.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Time to find out whether we're the "idiots" or the ones to leave victorious.
The black lava wall looms, its ancient terror undisguised.
The tunnel is as quiet as a tomb; even a dropping pin would send waves of echoes between the walls. The unwanted visitors lower their voices.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, Ms. Stranger and Ms. Radio have settled down in the suitcase.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you, Sonetto. It's the safest place for them to stay now that we're getting deeper into the volcano.
She snaps the clasps shut and picks up the suitcase.
She forces herself forward, away from the terrifying gate at her back.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The sanctuary is just ahead. Manus Vindictae should be holding the ritual there.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Should the worst happen, you know what to do.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Oh, and, I'd like you to have this.
The crumpled hand-drawn map bears deep red markings, old records now interlaced with fresh annotations.
This map, soaked with Nautika's sweat and tears, has at last found the promised land.
But in a way no one had ever hoped.
She takes the map without a word, her unspoken feelings driving her every step.
The oppressive silence makes every scattered brush of boot on stone unbearably loud.
Someone's pace quickens until a loose stone trips her.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Urgh!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Careful, Sonetto. Are you alright?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you ... shaking?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't mind me, Timekeeper. It must be the cold air.
She straightens her body, though her arm remains stiff and held at an unnatural angle.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Even the warming incantation is failing.
She pauses. A wavering hint of pain creeps into her voice.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Is this how Ms. Amundsen felt when she passed through the gate?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She was so brave. Braver than I could ever be. I wish I had the same courage to pursue what I want.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry, Timekeeper. This isn't the time.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Let's move on. There's still much to be done.
With a deep breath, Sonetto suppresses the shaking in her words.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: "We must turn our eyes to the supreme mission alone."
Muttering to herself, she takes another step forward.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The ritual must be stopped. Shall we go, Timekeeper?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes.
The sound of hurried footsteps rises again.
This time, it's met with an echo from the far end of the tunnel.
Footsteps come to a sudden stop, the ring of metallic ornaments lingering in the air.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Sophia!
The air hangs stagnant in the dark space, yet the Preacher's shadow dances wildly over the stone walls.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto.
Sonetto exchanges a glance with her, then nods, arcane energy coalescing at the tip of her glasfeder.
The Preacher tightens her grip on the idol, and radiance surges forth from it.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Διορθωθεί   το   σφάλμα!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Now, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: *coughing* What's ...
A haze of pink and purple smoke billows out. When the dust settles, only a hat remains.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Run!
Sonetto springs into action, but another wave of dense mist rolls out from the tunnel, cutting her off.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This mist ... It's not from the Misty Bubble Ball.
Odorless, thin, yet oppressive and omnipresent, like the fog over the lake trying to turn the Spinning Wheel.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Stay where you are!
Through the mist, Sonetto jerks to an abrupt halt.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It looks just like the mist that hangs over the lake in the suitcase. You collapsed in it once, remember?

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: You cannot escape!
The black mucus surges forward again, chasing after those attempting to flee.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Regna   sereno   intenso   ed   infinito!
The arcane skill intercepts the creeping black. Sonetto steps in front of the Preacher, her glasfeder gripped tight.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It seems this is the farthest I go.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, go on without me. I'll hold her off.
A final glance is exchanged before she disappears into the thickening mist.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: If you want to stop the Timekeeper, Ms. Sophia, you'll have to get past me first.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You once said that you'd draw steel the next we meet. Well, now's your chance.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Make your move.
The glow of arcane skills collides and flickers out in midair, over and over.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Sophia ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: To this day, I struggle to understand why you chose to stand against us.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Why did you turn your back on everything? On everyone you loved and who loved you?

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: You've changed.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Grown too fond of your own voice and paid too little attention to what's happening around you.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Are you sure this is where you want to be?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What do you mean?
The Preacher fixes her gaze on the tunnel's far end.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: As we speak, the Timekeeper is leaving your watch. Would the Foundation agree to this course of action?

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Shouldn't you be keeping your eyes on her, rather than wasting your words on me?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I trust the Timekeeper will fulfill her duty.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As for me—I will clear the dust off the path.
Every attacking gleam is caught and devoured by the viscous liquid surrounding the Preacher. Yet Sonetto keeps scribbling with her glasfeder in midair.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I have the same question for you, Ms. Sophia.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Is this where you want to be?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I saw how you fought on the island. Your arcane skills aren't at all like the ones you used back then.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You've changed, too. Something new has taken root and choked your old faith out from you.
A single streak of light finally breaks through, severing crimson strands at the Preacher's temple.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We must be close to the ritual site for you to show up.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Which means Dr. Dores is close by, doesn't it?
Sophia steps forward to meet those silent, resolute, unyielding eyes, as the surging black mucus solidifies into an impenetrable wall again.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Ms. Dores came to us led by nothing but her own purpose.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: But what of you, Sonetto?
The Preacher raises a hand; the little idol sways gently against her chest.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: What's your purpose in all this?
Her grip tightens around her glasfeder. Just as she has done countless times before, she raises it into the air.
TO BE CONTINUED…
